title: MicroPad MQTT Event
description: One action event published by the MicroPad firmware on topic micropad/event. action is always present; entity, value, page_id, and target_page are emitted only when meaningful, matching the firmware serializer and the backend dispatch conditions. An adjust event carries the row's new value (the encoder turned on a slider row).
